senses.gloss: m. (v. preced. art.; cmp. Assyr. tukku shield, a. Lat. scutum a. scutella) salver, tray (of twisted osiers).
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 42a:6">Ber. 42ᵃ</cite> <he>לבתר דסליק ת׳ וכ׳</he> after the tray before them was removed.
<cite ref="Berakhot 42a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>אנן את׳ דריש וכ׳</he> we count on the tray of the Resh G’lutha (who sends us portions of what is placed before him).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 86a:4">B. Mets. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>קריבו ת׳ קמיה</he> they placed a tray before him (with food and drink).
<cite ref="Pesachim 110b:12">Pes. 110ᵇ</cite> <he>תרי קמי ת׳ וחד את׳</he> two cups before the tray is brought in, and one during the meal.
